# Data Source: tfe_saml_settings

(Only for Terraform Enterprise) Gets information on SAML settings.

This requires admin token configuration. See example usage for incorporating an admin token in your provider config.

## Example Usage

```go
import constructs "github.com/aws/constructs-go/constructs"
import "github.com/hashicorp/terraform-cdk-go/cdktf"
/*Provider bindings are generated by running cdktf get.
See https://cdk.tf/provider-generation for more details.*/
import "github.com/aws-samples/dummy/gen/providers/tfe/provider"
import "github.com/aws-samples/dummy/gen/providers/tfe/dataTfeSamlSettings"
type myConvertedCode struct {
	TerraformStack
}

func newMyConvertedCode(scope Construct, name *string) *myConvertedCode {
	this := &myConvertedCode{}
	cdktf.NewTerraformStack_Override(this, scope, name)
	/*Terraform Variables are not always the best fit for getting inputs in the context of Terraform CDK.
	    You can read more about this at https://cdk.tf/variables*/
	adminToken := cdktf.NewTerraformVariable(this, jsii.String("admin_token"), &TerraformVariableConfig{
		Description: jsii.String("An admin access token"),
	})
	hostname := cdktf.NewTerraformVariable(this, jsii.String("hostname"), &TerraformVariableConfig{
		Default: jsii.String("app.terraform.io"),
		Description: jsii.String("The HCP Terraform or Enterprise hostname."),
	})
	token := cdktf.NewTerraformVariable(this, jsii.String("token"), &TerraformVariableConfig{
		Description: jsii.String("An access token"),
	})
	provider.NewTfeProvider(this, jsii.String("tfe"), &TfeProviderConfig{
		hostname: hostname.stringValue,
		token: token.stringValue,
	})
	tfeAdmin := provider.NewTfeProvider(this, jsii.String("tfe_4"), &TfeProviderConfig{
		alias: jsii.String("admin"),
		hostname: hostname.stringValue,
		token: adminToken.stringValue,
	})
	dataTfeSamlSettings.NewDataTfeSamlSettings(this, jsii.String("foo"), &DataTfeSamlSettingsConfig{
		provider: tfeAdmin,
	})
	return this
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `AcsConsumerUrl` (String) ACS Consumer (Recipient) URL.
- `AttrGroups` (String) Name of the SAML attribute that determines team membership.
- `AttrSiteAdmin` (String) Site admin access role.
- `AttrUsername` (String) Name of the SAML attribute that determines the user's username.
- `AuthnRequestsSigned` (Boolean) Whether `<samlp:AuthnRequest>` messages are signed.
- `Certificate` (String) Request and assertion signing certificate.
- `Debug` (Boolean) Whether debug mode is enabled, which means that the SAMLResponse XML will be displayed on the login page.
- `Enabled` (Boolean) Whether SAML single sign-on is enabled.
- `Id` (String) ID of the SAML settings. It is always `Saml`.
- `IdpCert` (String) PEM encoded X.509 Certificate as provided by the IdP configuration.
- `MetadataUrl` (String) Metadata (Audience) URL.
- `OldIdpCert` (String) Previous version of the PEM encoded X.509 Certificate as provided by the IdP configuration.
- `PrivateKey` (String, Sensitive) The private key used for request and assertion signing.
- `ProviderType` (String) The type of identity provider used. One of `Okta`, `Entra`, `Saml`, or `Unknown`.
- `SignatureDigestMethod` (String) Signature Digest Method.
- `SignatureSigningMethod` (String) Signature Signing Method.
- `SiteAdminRole` (String) Site admin access role.
- `SloEndpointUrl` (String) Single Log Out URL.
- `SsoApiTokenSessionTimeout` (Number) Single Sign On session timeout in seconds.
- `SsoEndpointUrl` (String) Single Sign On URL.
- `TeamManagementEnabled` (Boolean) Whether Terraform Enterprise is set to manage team membership.
- `WantAssertionsSigned` (Boolean) Whether `<saml:Assertion>` elements are signed.
